claims.statement: FDA guidance recommends fit-for-purpose selection and validation of digital technologies used for remote trial data.
EEG-BIDS is a published standardized extension of BIDS for electroencephalography.

contrary_evidence: Central EEG vendors and academic pipelines already perform QC.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: central EEG labs and CRO protocol teams.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 100 studies at 100000 PLN yield 10 million PLN revenue and founder equity above 5 million PLN in six to eight years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly with neurophysiology reviewers.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 20000-80000 PLN setup plus 40-150 PLN per recording.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: validated pipelines repeat across studies.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: More devices, artifacts, and adjudications expand benchmark coverage
fingerprint.customer: CROs and multi-site EEG research sponsors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: CRO protocol specification and central-lab partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Automated QC with expert escalation and site benchmarks
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The sponsor pays at setup and per recording
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A study needs early proof that recordings are usable

founder_fit: EEG and data-science experience provide rare credibility without camera-led distribution.
risks: False passes corrupt endpoints and false fails waste recordings.

structure.control_point: A de-identified corpus linking artifacts and deviations to expert labels and usability
structure.critical_dependency: Learning rights and reproducible expert agreement

thesis: Protocol-aware EEG quality assurance for CROs builds a cross-device annotated artifact corpus and site benchmark from every study.
title: NeuroQC Benchmark
uncertainties: Training rights, cross-device accuracy, and study volume are unknown.
